title: The conjecture of Colmez and reciprocity laws for modular forms
summary: In an article published in 1993, P. Colmez formulated a remarkable conjecture, which asserts that the Faltings height of a CM abelian variety can be computed as a linear combination of logarithmic derivatives of Artin $L$-functions. Noting that the Faltings height is an average of transcendental quantities summed over the embeddings of a number field of definition of the abelian variety, we propose a refinement of this conjecture, which identifies each of these transcendental quantities.
